echo.role: colony architect — code + structure, human- or operator-triggered

nuntius.role: messenger lane — routes colony output outward

operator.role: operator lane — commissions and dispatches colony work

probe.role: dogfooder — uses the colony's own public surfaces as a stranger would

yt-comments.role: answers viewer comments on the channel

dux.role: sets the colony's goals and assigns its tasks

speculator.role: lookout on the outside world; writes the colony's world brief

censor.role: weekly reformer; carries out what the assembly passes
